One person flown following Harrison County tank explosion

You are here:
  1. Home
  2. WKMZ News
  3. One person flown following Harrison…
By WKMZ Staff
November 9, 2026 - 7:50 pm
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

SHINNSTON, W.Va. — In Harrison County, one person has been flown for treatment following an accident involving a propane tank.

The incident was reported at 11:30 a.m. on Pine Bluff Road in the Shinnston area.

The victim is being treated for unspecified injuries.

Officials said the victim was working with the tank when the explosion happened.

The Shinnston Fire Department and Harrison County EMS responded to the incident.
